svg.title: Changing of the guard: Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. At night, the white columned portico of the White House West Wing glows, its doorway lit gold. Stephen Miller, bald, in a slim dark suit and tie, stands in the doorway while Susie Wiles, with short pale-blonde hair and a dark suit, walks away down the driveway. Above the pediment, a huge blank phone screen glows in a crimson sky like a moon, and silhouetted press with a TV camera and a boom microphone watch from the foreground. Represents President Trump announcing on Truth Social on Nov. 6, 2026, that Miller will replace Wiles as chief of staff; the handover scene and the phone are editorial symbols, not a reported moment.
